about: The block-by-block workshop's third round of crit, from the walk-in to deep dive 1's statement (m001 to m033), as Noah left it on October 21, 2026. His notes are also in design/history/data/compass.js, word for word. Moment IDs are this round's; labels say which moment each was. After this round the deep dives and the closing got workshops of their own (blocks.html?block=dive1, dive2, dive3, closing).

notes.m001: Great, but the door opening and the intro seem to have kind of low frame rates. I'm not sure why. Maybe it's just a screen recording issue, or maybe you purposefully slowed down the footage. I'd ask you not to do that. I want the highest frame rate possible.
notes.m002: You could cut it even earlier, just slightly, so that we start on the motion of us coming down, right in the motion.
notes.m003: I'm seeing a little bit of lag on the screen. That might be a screen recording issue, but again, I want our recordings to be perfectly clear and the framerate they came in
notes.m007: Not liking how the letters kind of jump out. I think we should just stick to the fade/slide in of the other headers
notes.m008: When the word mark kind of disappears from the screen, right now it just fades and moves a little up. I think that could be a little bit accentuated. We could have it just slide up a little quicker and fade out in that process. It should be kind of subtle but also kind of animated. Keep that in mind for just all future, scenes and sections, things that kind of lead to other things, should always end with some sort of fleeting motion, even if it's subtle and it fades out quickly, it should lead with motion.
notes.m009: Amazing. Exactly what we need. I think just for future reference, whenever an overlay is shown, I think it would be awesome, if we could have the box slide up with the text, when it fades, and I think the cursor could come from different directions to the highlighted word. So for instance, right now it's coming from the bottom right to the word brief, maybe on the next one it comes from the top left, then bottom left, top right, just different directions so we keep it new every single time. But other than that, really good.
notes.m010: Great. Just. Refer to the feedback about the cursor coming from different directions. Looks amazing.
notes.m011: Loving the context, it's awesome. Really, really awesome.
notes.m013: I'm not liking the expansion effect of the grid before, we could zoom out. I think we could lose that or make it much, much more subtle. But yeah, other than that, really great work.
notes.m015: For some reason, the screen recording's a little bit laggy again, but I think that's just an issue with the screen recording. Looks good.
notes.m020: Again, a little bit laggy with the screen recording, but I trust that this looks good.
notes.m021: I'm seeing kind of a pixel glitch, or sorry, just a screen glitch of seeing the next section at the very end of this recording. Maybe that's just because it fades out, and the screen recording is a little bit faulty, but let's just make sure that there isn't any glitching going on throughout the video. Looks really good. Again, just refer to the cursor feedback and how the block follows the word out.
notes.m022: I think we could keep the icon black, but for now, looks amazing.
notes.m024: There's this weird jitter with the top kind of bar. I don't want that to happen.
notes.m027: The keybines don't seem to fade out subtly, like we discussed. I'm hoping we can fix that.
